query:
SELECT values->'value'->0->>'entity_id' AS "project_id?"
               FROM entity_properties
               WHERE entity_id = $1
                 AND entity_type = 'TASK'
                 AND property_definition_id = '00000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000014'
                 AND values->'value'->0->>'entity_type' = 'INITIATIVE'
